newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore's Pidemco eyes Canary Wharf development.
newsitem.headline: Singapore's Pidemco eyes Canary Wharf development.

text.p: Singapore's Pidemco Land Ltd said on Wednesday it was looking into the possibility of investing in London's Canary Wharf development in the Docklands.

"We are looking at Canary Wharf...and we are having discussions with the owner, Canary Wharf Ltd," said Liew Mun Leong, Pidemco Land president, speaking after a news conference on Pidemco's Cuppage Centre project in Singapore.
He said an announcement would be made early next month.
He denied Singapore press reports which said Pidemco would buy a stake from Hotel Properties, which also has an interest in a residential, hotel and leisure project along the Canary Wharf Docklands.
"Pidemco is not buying from Hotel Properties," he said.
Hotel Properties announced late last year it had planned a 300 million stg development in the area, which will be developed in phases over six years.
Government-owned Pidemco, due for eventual privatisation, is one of the biggest property owners and developers in Singapore.
